title: Expose review and audit gate planning in CLI workflows
acceptanceCriteria: Work create/edit or equivalent planning commands can declare required review and audit gates.
Evidence, verification, and summary commands expose review/audit gate status clearly.
Workflow docs and skills explain how to plan, satisfy, and force a review/audit gate.
Checkpoint outcome is recorded as a scoped commit or dirty-path reason code.
closedReason: review and audit gate CLI workflow exposure implemented and verified
